sentences.text: The allegations, as contained in the FIR, pertain to an incident dated 17.11.2018 involving a Mahindra pickup vehicle.

During the course of investigation, it has been alleged that the insurance policy in respect of the said vehicle was found to be fake, and that the present petitioner, being an agent of United India Insurance Company, was involved in the issuance of the said policy.

It is respectfully submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he, in his capacity as an insurance agent,
had issued a genuine insurance policy.
However, due to an inadvertent clerical mistake, the vehicle in question was wrongly reflected as a two-wheeler instead of a pickup vehicle in the said policy.

In the interim, direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner shall be released on interim bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 50,000/- with one surety of like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting authority in connection with the aforesaid case, subject to the condition that the petitioner shall cooperate with the investigation.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The allegations, as contained in the FIR, pertain to an incident dated 17.11.2018 involving a Mahindra pickup vehicle.
During the course of investigation, it has been alleged that the insurance policy in respect of the said vehicle was found to be fake, and that the present petitioner, being an agent of United India Insurance Company, was involved in the issuance of the said policy.
However, due to an inadvertent clerical mistake, the vehicle in question was wrongly reflected as a two-wheeler instead of a pickup vehicle in the said policy.

List the matter again on 29.04.2026.
